# Plotbird

Plotbird is a Christchurch, New Zealand aerial mapping and property imagery business.

Canonical website: https://plotbird.co.nz/
Contact: plotbirdnz@gmail.com
Service area: Christchurch and Canterbury, New Zealand.

## Core services

- Drone mapping and orthomosaic imagery: https://plotbird.co.nz/drone-mapping-christchurch/
- Aerial property photography and video: https://plotbird.co.nz/aerial-photography-christchurch/
- Drone photogrammetry and 3D property models: https://plotbird.co.nz/photogrammetry-christchurch/
- Farm and rural drone mapping: https://plotbird.co.nz/farm-drone-mapping-canterbury/

Plotbird focuses on practical property-sized jobs and useful deliverables rather than large survey programmes.

Plotbird is not a licensed cadastral or engineering surveying practice. Where work requires a licensed surveyor or another regulated professional, Plotbird does not represent its visual mapping as a substitute.

Portfolio examples on the site include farm, urban and shoreline mapping projects captured around Christchurch.
